name: Omanote
author: Michele Belleri
description: Omanote in the bar, like the app on a phone: folders, notes and the note itself, editable right in the panel. Notes sync with Joplin Server through the Omanote app.

barWidget.description: Folders, notes and note editing in a panel. Click for the panel, right-click to show or hide the app, middle-click for a new note.

schema.label: Show the first lines of each note
